# The A0.1 artifact set: one line per shipped binary, `<package> <binary>`.
#
# Single source of truth for two workflows:
#   * release.yml  builds exactly these, and emits one SBOM per line;
#   * ci.yml's `provenance-dry-run` asserts that this list plus the `!`
#     exclusions below accounts for *every* bin target in the workspace — so a
#     new or renamed binary cannot silently fall out of the release.
#
# A line starting with `!` names a package whose binaries are deliberately not
# shipped. Add one only with a reason.

aksond aksond
akson-cli akson
akson-mcp akson-mcp
akson-adapter-openai akson-adapter-openai
akson-adapter-anthropic akson-adapter-anthropic
akson-adapter-gemini akson-adapter-gemini

# Test/bench driver for the harness, not a product surface.
!akson-harness
